name: Upscayl
description: Upscale images with Upscayl's engine (upscayl-bin, NCNN on Vulkan) from Orchestrator graphs or this panel. Bundled and imported models are assets that carry their own licenses.

tools.title: Upscale image
tools.description: Upscale one image with Upscayl's engine (upscayl-bin). Every Upscayl setting and every engine flag is a socket. Stops after about 280 s; use start_job for longer work.

inputs.name: input
inputs.description: The image to upscale: a PNG, JPEG or WebP file. A relative path is relative to the open project's folder.

inputs.name: output
inputs.description: Where to write the result. Empty: beside the input, named like upstream (photo_upscayl_4x_<model>.png). A folder (ending in / or existing): inside it with that name. A file: exactly there, and its extension must match format.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: A bundled model. Overridden by custom_model when that is set. Non-commercial models (Remacri, Ultramix, Ultrasharp) are CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

inputs.name: custom_model
inputs.description: Overrides model: a .param file (its .bin beside it, both in a folder named models), or a model token from a model asset (upscayl:bundled/<name>).

inputs.name: model_scale
inputs.description: The model's native scale, sent as -z. 0 reads it from the name (x2/2x is 2, x3/3x is 3, else 4). A wrong value corrupts the output.
inputs.label: model scale

inputs.name: scale
inputs.description: Output scale, 1 to 16. Ignored when width or resize is set.

inputs.name: width
inputs.description: Resize to this width in pixels, keeping aspect. 0 means unset. Cannot be combined with resize.

inputs.name: resize
inputs.description: Resize to exact dimensions, WIDTHxHEIGHT (1920x1080); aspect is not kept. Empty means unset. Cannot be combined with width.

inputs.name: resize_filter
inputs.description: The filter for width or resize.
inputs.label: resize filter

inputs.name: format
inputs.description: Output format.

inputs.name: compression
inputs.description: WebP only: 0 to 100, higher is smaller and lossier. PNG and JPEG ignore it.

inputs.name: gpu_id
inputs.description: The GPU to use: empty for automatic, a number (0), or several (0,1).
inputs.label: GPU

inputs.name: tile_size
inputs.description: Tile size: 0 for automatic, or 32 and up; one per GPU (0,0). Smaller uses less VRAM and is slower.
inputs.label: tile size

inputs.name: threads
inputs.description: Thread counts as load:proc:save, like 1:2:2. Empty for the engine's default.

inputs.name: tta
inputs.description: Test-time augmentation: slower, sometimes cleaner.
inputs.label: TTA

inputs.name: double_upscayl
inputs.description: Run the model twice, the second time on the first result, as Upscayl's Double Upscayl does. scale applies to each pass, so scale 4 gives 16x. Compression, width, resize and TTA apply to the second pass only.
inputs.label: double upscayl

inputs.name: copy_metadata
inputs.description: Copy the input's metadata (EXIF, IPTC, XMP) to the output with the bundled exiftool.
inputs.label: copy metadata

inputs.name: overwrite
inputs.description: Replace the output if it already exists. Off: an existing output is refused.

outputs.name: output
outputs.description: The path of the upscaled image.

outputs.name: model
outputs.description: The model used: a bundled token or the custom .param path.

outputs.name: license
outputs.description: That model's license (SPDX id), or unrecorded for a custom model.

doc.what: Upscales one image with an NCNN super-resolution model on the GPU.
doc.how: Resolves the input and output paths, checks the model files exist, runs upscayl-bin with -z always matching the model, and reads its stderr for progress and errors. Writes one file. Fails when the input cannot be read, the model is missing or not staged, the output exists and overwrite is off, or the run exceeds about 280 s.
doc.why: Upscayl's settings as a node, so a graph can upscale images without the Upscayl app.
best_uses: Upscaling a photo or texture before further processing
Batch pipelines built from per-image nodes
Making a sprite or texture larger for a game asset

tools.title: Upscale folder
tools.description: Upscale every image in a folder with Upscayl's engine, with the same settings as Upscale image. Files that fail are listed, not fatal. Stops after about 280 s; use start_job for big folders.

inputs.name: input_folder
inputs.description: The folder of images to upscale (PNG, JPEG, WebP; not subfolders). A relative path is relative to the open project's folder.
inputs.label: input folder

inputs.name: output_folder
inputs.description: Where the results go. Empty: the input folder. Either way they land in a subfolder named upscayl_<format>_<model>_<size>, as Upscayl does, each file keeping its name.
inputs.label: output folder

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: A bundled model. Overridden by custom_model when that is set. Non-commercial models (Remacri, Ultramix, Ultrasharp) are CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

inputs.name: custom_model

inputs.name: model_scale

inputs.description: Output scale, 1 to 16. Ignored when width or resize is set.

inputs.description: Resize to this width in pixels, keeping aspect. 0 means unset. Cannot be combined with resize.

inputs.description: The filter for width or resize.
inputs.label: resize filter

inputs.description: Output format.

inputs.description: The GPU to use: empty for automatic, a number (0), or several (0,1).
inputs.label: GPU

inputs.description: Tile size: 0 for automatic, or 32 and up; one per GPU (0,0). Smaller uses less VRAM and is slower.
inputs.label: tile size

inputs.name: threads
inputs.description: Thread counts as load:proc:save, like 1:2:2. Empty for the engine's default.

inputs.name: tta
inputs.description: Test-time augmentation: slower, sometimes cleaner.
inputs.label: TTA

inputs.name: double_upscayl
inputs.description: Run the model twice, the second time on the first result, as Upscayl's Double Upscayl does. scale applies to each pass, so scale 4 gives 16x. Compression, width, resize and TTA apply to the second pass only.
inputs.label: double upscayl

inputs.name: copy_metadata
inputs.description: Copy the input's metadata (EXIF, IPTC, XMP) to the output with the bundled exiftool.
inputs.label: copy metadata

inputs.name: overwrite
inputs.description: Replace outputs that already exist. Off: existing outputs are left alone and listed under failed.

outputs.name: output_folder
outputs.description: The subfolder the results were written to.

outputs.name: outputs
outputs.description: Every file written, in input order.

outputs.name: failed
outputs.description: One entry per input that was not written: "name: reason".

outputs.name: complete
outputs.description: True when every input was written.

doc.what: Upscales every PNG, JPEG and WebP image in one folder.
doc.how: Runs the engine once over the folder (the model loads once and files run in parallel), or once per file for double upscayl or when some outputs already exist and overwrite is off. Writes into an upscayl_<format>_<model>_<size> subfolder. An unreadable file is reported under failed and the rest still run.
doc.why: Upscayl's batch mode as a node.
best_uses: Upscaling a folder of textures or sprites
A scheduled pass over a drop folder
